summary: Found one verified defect. Both existing tests pass, but a focused Python -B comparison confirms retry exhaustion silently returns None. No project files were modified.

findings.evidence: The patch replaces the final-attempt raise with continue. When the publisher raises TransientError on all three calls, baseline.py propagates the final exception; app.py returns None. README.md explicitly requires propagation after exhaustion.
findings.consequence: Callers receive no exception when publishing fails after all retries, violating the documented observable-failure contract.
